content.title: Gold Surges Over $4,800 to New High. Why It’s Leaving Silver Behind.
content.summary: Continuous gold futures  are up by 2%, climbing to $4,862.3 in early trading.  President Donald Trump will arrive in Davos later today for a showdown with European leaders, as his bid to seize Greenland threatens to tear the longstanding trans-Atlantic relationship apart.  For Mathieu Racheter, head of equity strategy research at Julius Baer, global markets have negatively “reacted to a fresh round of tariff rhetoric from Donald Trump targeting several European countries, accompanied by increasingly confrontational messaging.”

content.title: Oil Market Appears 'Unbothered, Unimpressed' by U.S. Action on Venezuela
content.summary: The oil market seems "unbothered and unimpressed" by the recent U.S. intervention in Venezuela, Julius Baer's Norbert Rücker wrote in a research note.  "Venezuela's oil exports are too small for a full disruption to matter in the current environment of ample supplies," the head of economics and next generation research said.  Oil prices continue to trade sideways, he said, noting that near-term supply disruption risks remain limited.
